name: Uragiri wa Boku no Namae o Shitteiru -Tasogare ni Ochita Inori-
original_name: 裏切りは僕の名前を知っている -黄昏に堕ちた祈り-
source: Sakurai Yuki is a teenager with a mysterious power. He was abandoned at birth near the Asahi orphanage. Because of that event, Yuki strives for independence. He hates being a burden to anyone near him, but at the same time, he is afraid of being left alone. Moreover, ever since he can remember, he has had a strange ability that when he touches others, he can feel their emotion. Unable to control it, he's often made insensitive blunders in the past. He later meets a mysterious yet beautiful stranger who saves his life, but for some reason he feels like they've met before. While death looms and his ability gets stronger and stronger, a man who claims to be his older brother suddenly appears, which raises the question, "What will Yuki do when he learns the truth?"
translation: 樱井由纪是一位拥有神秘力量的少年。他一出生就被遗弃在朝日孤儿院附近。由于那件事，由纪努力争取独立。他讨厌成为身边任何人的负担，但同时，他又害怕被留下一个人。而且，从他有记忆起，他就拥有一种奇怪的能力，当他触碰别人时，他能感受到他们的情绪。由于无法控制，他过去常常犯下麻木不仁的错误。后来他遇到了一位神秘而美丽的陌生人，他救了他的命，但出于某种原因，他感觉他们以前见过。当死亡迫在眉睫，他的能力越来越强时，一个自称是他哥哥的男人突然出现，这引发了一个问题：“当他得知真相后，他会做什么？”
